overview: Palestine is the name for the Palestinian territories of the West Bank, including East Jerusalem, and the Gaza Strip. The State of Palestine is recognised by most members of the United Nations and has observer status there. Israel has occupied the West Bank since 1967, Gaza has been devastated by war since 2023, and the conflict between Israelis and Palestinians remains unresolved. Arabic is the official language.

geography.text: The West Bank lies west of the Jordan River. It is mostly hilly, with the Jordan Valley and the shore of the Dead Sea along its eastern edge. The Gaza Strip is a small, flat and very densely populated strip of land on the Mediterranean coast, bordering Israel and Egypt.
